Game Overview

Squid Survival Game puts players into a casual experience centered on carefully extract shapes from fragile honeycomb candy, testing your precision and nerves. Succeed to advance, but a single crack means defeat. This nostalgic yet thrilling experience keeps you on edge, blending skill and suspense perfectly.
